It further provides the analytical solution involving integration along the ray. Source [S7] confirms this by providing the same differential equation and its discrete implementation (ray marching) formula, which combines background attenuation and accumulated emission. Source [S1] also mentions that semi-transparent methods accumulate emission and light. All facts in the claim are present in the evidence.
